in_arabic.name: جبريل
in_arabic.meaning: ملاك الله جبرائيل، الروح الأمين، مبشر النبوة
in_arabic.long_meaning: جبريل هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه ملاك الله جبرائيل، الروح الأمين، مبشر النبوة. وهو أحد الملائكة في الإسلام، ويُعرف أيضًا بالروح الأمين. ذُكر اسم جبريل في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، و هو الملاك الموكل بالوحي إلى الأنبياء.

in_hindi.name: जिब्रील
in_hindi.meaning: ईश्वर का दूत जिब्रील, आध्यात्मिक आत्मा, भविष्यवाणी का दाता
in_hindi.long_meaning: जिब्रील एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है। इसका अर्थ है ईश्वर का दूत जिब्रील, आध्यात्मिक आत्मा, भविष्यवाणी का दाता। जिब्रील इस्लामी परंपरा में एक देवदूत का नाम है जिसे आत्मा भी कहा जाता है। यह देवदूत पैगंबरों को संदेश देने वाला होता है। इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी मिलता है।

in_pashto.name: جبراييل
in_pashto.meaning: د الله فرښته جبراييل، روح الامين، د نبوت مبشر
in_pashto.long_meaning: جبراييل د يو مذکر نوم دی، چي اصلي يې عربي دی. مطلب يې د الله فرښته جبراييل، روح الامين، د نبوت مبشر دی. جبراييل په اسلام کې د فرښتو يو نوم دی، چي روح الامين هم ورته وايي. دا فرښته د انبيا لپاره وحي راوړونکی دی. په قرآن کريم کې يې ذکر شوی دی.

in_english.name: Jibreela
in_english.meaning: Angel of God, Messenger of Divine Revelation
in_english.long_meaning: Jibreela is a masculine name derived from Arabic roots. It signifies 'Angel of God' or 'Messenger of Divine Revelation'. In Islamic tradition, Jibreela (also known as Gabriel) is the name of an angel who serves as a messenger of God. He is often referred to as 'Ruh al-Amin' (the Trustworthy Spirit). Jibreela plays a crucial role in Islamic theology, particularly in the delivery of divine revelations to prophets. The name is mentioned multiple times in the Quran and holds significant spiritual and cultural importance across Muslim communities worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: Jibreela is a beautiful and evocative name in the Islamic world. It holds deep cultural significance as it represents the Islamic belief in angels and their roles in guiding and protecting people. The name Jibreela is often used in various Islamic traditions and literatures, such as Sufism and Folklore, to symbolize the gentle and comforting presence of an angelic being.
data.spiritual_significance: Jibreela's name holds a special spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. She is believed to be one of the angelic beings that bring comfort, serenity, and protection to those who call upon her. Jibreela is often invoked in times of distress or difficulty, as her gentle presence is believed to bring peace and solace to those who are in need. Additionally, Jibreela is often seen as a symbol of mercy, compassion, and the divine nearness of God. Her name serves as a reminder that even in the darkest of times, kindness, gentleness, and divine protection are always present.
